latest.title: AWS for Students: 5 Cloud Computing Concepts Every Beginner Should Understand ☁️
latest.description:
In this article, I explore five essential AWS services that every beginner should understand: Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, AWS IAM, and Amazon CloudWatch.

As a Computer Science student specializing in Data Science, I share my understanding of how these services support cloud computing, data storage, application development, security, and monitoring. I also explain how these services can work together in a simple data-processing workflow.

trending.title: Lambda Web Functions in Terraform: what hashicorp/aws rejects and awscc already accepts
trending.description: AWS Lambda Web Functions run a plain Node.js HTTP server, and one aws lambda-web deploy command creates the bucket, role, function, revision and endpoint for you. I ran the server locally, then tried to model it in Terraform: hashicorp/aws 6.69.1 fails validation on the resource type, while awscc 1.106.0 accepts all three resources. The article covers what the CLI leaves behind after a delete and the multi-Region settings you can't change later.
